New from me: Less than 5 percent of DA's offices have a unit tasked with seeking out wrongful convictions. I spoke with Marissa Bluestine of the Quattrone Center about what these units do well, what they could do better, and the obstacles they face.

(Link follows)

Despite (or because of) their success, CIUs now get pushback from Republican attorneys general, police departments who don't like to see their incompetence/corruption exposed, and city officials who fear the lawsuits wrought by exonerations.

We say goodbye to this handsome gentleman today. 

My wife @LilianaSegura adopted Wally 15 years ago. I don't know that any dog and human could be more perfectly suited for one another. Wally was nearly feral when Liliana got him. She spent the next several years . . .

. . . building his confidence and coaxing out the magnificent beast within him. I first met Wally five years into his life, and only got to see the marvelous result -- this loyal, determined, gentle, awkward, wonderfully empathetic fellow. Truly one of the Seven Great Dogs of his time. We will miss him terribly.

Headline of the day

www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026...
John Lewis photobombs ICE from the grave.

He was hilarious in Veep. And in a very funny but short lived show about a local TV news crew in Spokane. 

Unless you’re talking about that bearded, what-is-a-woman dick.

Then no.

Friday, federal prosecutors dropped charges related to a January church protest against a woman who argues she was never there.

Attorneys for three defendants argued that prosecutors knew those charges were false and declined to tell the court before asking for more time to turn over evidence.
Robert E. Lee got his ass beat at Gettysburg by a professor of rhetoric and oratory from Bowdoin College and generations of reactionary fantasists have died mad about it.

justice alito talmbout it "seriously undermines" voter confidence when a "big stash" of mail ballots arrives and changes the "apparent outcome" 

sir do you mean when all the votes are counted? bc it sounds like you're just describing when all the votes are counted

Yes!

He actually said these words.

It’s really a testament to Trump’s weird obsessions that that letting states make their own election policies is now the blue position, while a top-down, one-size fits all policy that hurts rural voters is the red one.
Also "Justice Alito" and "Ketanji".

Today's #SCOTUS Order List includes a 6-3 summary reversal, in which the Republican appointees all vote, contra the Second Circuit, that qualifed immunity insulates a police officer from damages for using a rear wristlock against a nonviolent protestor.

The Democratic appointees all dissent:

The Supreme Court refuses to review an odious 5th Circuit decision granting qualified immunity to Texas officials who arrested a citizens-journalist in retaliation against her posing questions to public officials. Sotomayor has an appropriately furious dissent: www.supremecourt.gov/orders/court...

It would've been reckless and inexcusable to cause generational damage by illegally defunding USAID, NIH, HHS, Dept of Edu, and so on just to reduce the deficit...

... but spending and the deficit are both higher than '22, '23, '24. It was all just harm for harm's sake. The cruelty was the point.

Once again, free passes for the minyan of Republicans who are the only people in DC who can stop the runaway Mad King. And yet, tomorrow, Lisa Murkowski, Thom Tills, John Thune, & Susan Collins will continue to be able to appear in public without facing any questions about enabling fascism.
Also, the pipeline between stand up comedy and fascism and/or cult leader.

Squeezed by data centers' relentless demand for electricity, a Nevada energy company just said it's going to stop supplying energy to Tahoe. The city has a year to figure out how to meet 75% of its energy needs without it.
